notes: Rental flats excluded: 326A stacks 331/333 storeys 2-18 (34) and 327A stacks 367/369 storeys 2-9 (16) = 50, as marked RENTAL on brochure pp.16-19 and the site plan table. Sale units counted 1221 = brochure 118 T1 + 358 T2 + 745 4-Room.
Unit distribution read by sampling cell colours on brochure pages 10-12 (PDF), every cell classified against the legend (max colour error 16/255).

All coordinates are brochure PDF points: site plan page 9 (north arrow points straight up, north_bearing_deg 0; 150 m bar = 254.6 pt, 1.697 pt/m), floor plans pages 14-32 (10 m bar = 79.69 pt, 7.969 pt/m). Board annotations were mapped to brochure coordinates via the embedded site-plan image bbox in board.pdf.

gt30m: board row3 has 72 vector semicircles (radius 23.6 pt = 13.9 m, labelled 15m; two facing ones meet at ~30 m), each a single solid colour. Each was attributed to the stack whose site-plan label its centre lies on (all within 7.8 pt; next stack >= 6.3 pt away). A stack passes only if all its own semicircles are green. Pass 1 = vector fill colours; pass 2 = fresh 900 dpi render, pixel hue sampled only where no other semicircle overlaps. Pass 2 matched pass 1 on every semicircle with >=20 exclusive samples; semicircles #0 (326A 319) and #9 (326A 323) had 7-8 exclusive samples that read red because the red/salmon flat colour of the plan shows through the translucent green; resolved green by vector colour and visual check; both stacks fail on another red semicircle anyway. #13 (326B 355) and #42 (325A 311) had no exclusive area; vector colour used. No stack-level disagreement. 12 pass, 35 fail.
Stacks whose own semicircles are green but are overlapped by a neighbour's red semicircle pass with confidence medium.

facing from board row5 arrows (colour legend NW magenta, NE blue, SW red, SE purple); one arrow per stack (47), arrow bearings agree with the labels and with the floor plan living-room sides. One stray SE arrow below the site (near the scale bar) and the 4 legend arrows ignored.

Facilities: board row2 has 24 circles of radius 50.2 pt (= 29.6 m, labelled 30m) used here; an older set of 14 radius-15 m circles at the same centres is superseded. Circle ids map to site-plan legend markers by the board number text, except the circle at the children's playground marker 1 between 326B and Blk 325, which the board labels '4'; the site-plan marker under it is 1 (Children's playground), used. Facility 7 'space reserved for future community use' mapped to 'Community space'. 8/10/11/12/13 are Blk 325 (MSCP) 1st-storey uses placed by the user on the car park footprint. facilities_near = circle intersects the stack footprint (segmented from the site-plan colours). facilities_has: only 326B (Residents' network centre at 1st storey, facilities_1st_storey.json); Blk 325 is the MSCP, not residential.

chute_m: straight line from the main door (read off gridded 220-400 dpi crops of the 3rd-storey plans; 331/333 from the 24th-storey plan p21, 367/369 from the 18th-storey plan p30 as they are rental below) to the nearer of the two chute openings (centralized refuse chute / recyclable refuse chute, about 3 m apart). Expect +/-1 m.
position: Corner = last door at a dead end of its corridor branch from the lift lobby. 326A 319/321 both sit at the tip of the NW branch; 321 is the last door.
roof_floors: all []. Floor plans only show 'ROOF AT 2ND/3RD STOREY ONLY' and 'ROOF (INACCESSIBLE)'; the only accessible roof garden is on the Blk 325 MSCP, which no unit opens onto.

wind_open: false if any footprint pixel of another residential block (other block number) lies within 30 m at bearing 90-135 deg from any footprint pixel of the stack. Same-block wings are not counted.

mscp_m: per stack, nearest footprint pixel to the Blk 325 car park outline from mscp_distance.json _geometry (brochure pt), at 1.697 pt/m, rounded to 5 m. Differs from the block-centre values in mscp_distance.json by more than 10 m for end stacks because this is per-stack nearest-edge (e.g. 326A 317 is 70 vs block 50; 328A 383 is 15 vs block 45).
mrt_m null: no MRT station on the site plan.
